easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Slurrk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
